_comments: The More Cheese shared key. Every credential this app ships (config/credentials) is encrypted with it, never with an install's own key, so the same release works on every install.

The key material is NOT in this repo. It is meant to be shared with anyone installing More Cheese, handed out through the More Cheese portal; an install puts it in MJAPI's environment as MORECHEESE_SHARED_KEY.

Without it the app installs and runs; the shipped credentials just stay encrypted (MJ logs one warning naming MORECHEESE_SHARED_KEY), and the features that need them (the demo Dropbox, the Skip dashboards' components) are unavailable.
Only read-only, demo-scoped secrets belong under this key: everyone who has it can read them all. To add or rotate one, see scripts/seal-credential.mjs and "Shared demo credentials" in the README.

fields.Name: More Cheese Shared Key
fields.Description: Encrypts the read-only demo credentials More Cheese ships (Dropbox, Skip component registry). The key is shared with everyone installing More Cheese through the More Cheese portal; set it as MORECHEESE_SHARED_KEY in MJAPI's environment.
